payload.primary_text: 人哋都走晒，我哋仲喺度等。
payload.transliteration: Yàhn deih dōu jáu saai, ngóh deih juhng hái douh dáng.
payload.translation: People have all left, but we are still waiting here.
payload.target_breakdown: 人哋 means “people/others” and functions as the subject of the sentence.

payload.primary_text: 點解你今日咁遲？
payload.transliteration: Dím gáai néih gām yaht gam chìh?
payload.translation: Why are you so late today?
payload.target_breakdown: 點解 is an interrogative adverb meaning “why” and introduces the question.

payload.primary_text: 佢終於出聲答我。
payload.transliteration: Kéuih jūng yū chēut sēng daap ngóh.
payload.translation: He finally spoke up to answer me.
payload.target_breakdown: 出聲 is a verb phrase meaning “to speak up/say” and is followed by 答我.

payload.primary_text: 呢度遊客好多，行得好慢。
payload.transliteration: Nī douh yàuh haak hóu dō, hàhng dāk hóu maahn.
payload.translation: There are lots of tourists here, and they walk very slowly.
payload.target_breakdown: 遊客 is a noun meaning “tourist(s)” and serves as the topic/subject of the clause.

payload.primary_text: 你本書放咗喺邊度？
payload.transliteration: Néih bún syū fong jó hái bīn douh?
payload.translation: Where did you put your book?
payload.target_breakdown: 邊度 is an interrogative locative meaning “where” and follows the preposition 喺.

payload.primary_text: 佢夜晚做工，晏晝瞓覺。
payload.transliteration: Kéuih jeh máahn juhk gūng, ngaam jauh fan gaau.
payload.translation: He works at night and sleeps in the afternoon.
payload.target_breakdown: 做工 is a verb phrase meaning “to work/do a job” and is the main predicate.

payload.primary_text: 我口渴，想飲水。
payload.transliteration: Ngóh háu gok, séung yám séui.
payload.translation: I am thirsty and want to drink water.
payload.target_breakdown: 飲 is a transitive verb meaning “to drink” and takes 水 as its object.

payload.primary_text: 佢唔飲酒，淨係飲茶。
payload.transliteration: Kéuih m̀h yám jáu, jingh haih yám chàh.
payload.translation: He doesn't drink alcohol; he only drinks tea.
payload.target_breakdown: 酒 is a noun meaning “alcohol/wine” and is the object of 飲.

payload.primary_text: 我生日嗰日，佢送我玫瑰花。
payload.transliteration: Ngóh sāng yaht gó yaht, kéuih sung ngóh muih gwāi fā.
payload.translation: On my birthday, he gave me roses.
payload.cloze_text: 我生日嗰日，佢___我玫瑰花。
payload.target_breakdown: 送 is a verb meaning “to give (as a gift)” and takes 我 as indirect object and 玫瑰花 as direct object.

payload.primary_text: 今年我哋去歐洲旅行。
payload.transliteration: Gām nìhn ngóh deih heui āu jāu léuih hàhng.
payload.translation: This year we are going to Europe for a trip.
payload.target_breakdown: 今年 is a time noun meaning “this year” and modifies the whole clause.

payload.primary_text: 我哋可以交換地址，好方便。
payload.transliteration: ngóh deih hó jáuh gāau wuhn deih jí, hóu fōng waih.
payload.translation: We can exchange addresses, which is convenient.
payload.target_breakdown: 交換 means “to exchange/switch” and is used as a transitive verb here, taking “地址” as its object.

payload.primary_text: 我買咗新衫，好靚喎。
payload.transliteration: ngóh jáuh jo sān sām, hóu leng wo.
payload.translation: I bought a new shirt; it’s really pretty.
payload.target_breakdown: 新 means “new” and is used as an attributive adjective modifying “衫”.

payload.primary_text: 好彩我帶咗傘，唔淋濕。
payload.transliteration: hóu chói ngóh daaih jo saan, m̀h làhm sahp.
payload.translation: Fortunately I brought an umbrella, so I didn’t get wet.
payload.target_breakdown: 好彩 means “fortunately” and is used as a sentence adverb at the beginning, commenting on the whole situation.

payload.primary_text: 而家天氣好熱，我唔想出門。
payload.transliteration: yìh gah tīn hei hóu yiht, ngóh m̀h séung chēut mùhn.
payload.translation: The weather is really hot these days, so I don’t want to go out.
payload.cloze_text: 而家天氣好____，我唔想出門。
payload.target_breakdown: 熱 means “hot” and is used as an adjective describing the weather.

payload.primary_text: 落雨咗，我哋改日再去公園吧。
payload.transliteration: lohk jyúh jo, ngóh deih gó yaht joi heui gūng yùhn bā.
payload.translation: It’s raining, so let’s go to the park another day.
payload.target_breakdown: 落雨 means “to rain / it’s raining” and functions as an intransitive verb phrase here.

payload.primary_text: 呢題數學題好難，我做唔到。
payload.transliteration: nī tòih suhk hohk tòih hóu nàhn, ngóh jouh m̀h dóu.
payload.translation: This math problem is too difficult; I can’t do it.
payload.cloze_text: 呢題數學題好____，我做唔到。
payload.target_breakdown: 難 means “difficult” and is used as an adjective after 好 to describe the degree of difficulty.

payload.primary_text: 路面濕濕，行路時要小心啲。
payload.transliteration: louh míhn sahp sahp, hàhng louh sìh yāu sāu sām dī.
payload.translation: The pavement is wet, so be careful when walking.
payload.target_breakdown: 小心 means “carefully” and is used as an adverb here, softened by 啲 in an imperative.

payload.primary_text: 我媽媽忙，我要照顧我個弟弟。
payload.transliteration: ngóh màh mà màhng, ngóh yāu jāu gu ngóh go daih dái.
payload.translation: My mom is busy, so I have to look after my younger brother.
payload.cloze_text: 我媽媽忙，我要____我個弟弟。
payload.target_breakdown: 照顧 means “to look after / care for” and is a transitive verb taking “我個弟弟” as its object.

payload.primary_text: 呢件事唔係你錯，唔好怪自己。
payload.transliteration: nī gin sih m̀h haih néih chō, m̀h hóu gwāi ji géi.
payload.translation: It’s not your fault; don’t blame yourself.
payload.cloze_text: 呢件事唔係你錯，唔好____自己。
payload.target_breakdown: 怪 means “to blame” and is used as a verb here, taking “自己” as its object.

payload.primary_text: 雖然試好難，我仲有信心可以考好。
payload.transliteration: sēung yìhn si hóu nàhn, ngóh juhng jáuh sàm sām hó jáuh háau hóu.
payload.translation: Although the exam is very difficult, I’m still confident I can do well.
payload.cloze_text: 雖然試好難，我仲____可以考好。
payload.target_breakdown: 有信心 means “confident” and functions as a predicate adjective phrase here, expressing the speaker’s assurance.
